atomic_statement_en: The defined request path GET /v1/openapi.json validates input before any allocation of long-running work.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: At the interface boundary, ApiOperation records shall carry tenant_id, revision, actor_id, occurred_at and a correlation ID wherever the operation changes durable state.
